hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -o pipefail
# Assume dbgap-etl role aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 \ --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl \ --role-session-name "facet-clear" > assume-role-output.txt
# Export temporary credentials export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g") export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g") export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g")
# Prepare payload cat > clear_facets_payload.json <<'EOF' { "Facet_Categories": ["Consortium_Curated_Facets"] } EOF
echo "Clearing all Consortium_Curated_Facets facets..."
HTTP_CODE=$(curl --silent --show-error --fail \ --retry 10 \ --retry-delay 5 \ --retry-all-errors \ --retry-connrefused \ --max-time 0 \ -o clear_facets_response.json \ -w "%{http_code}" \ -X POST \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data-binary @clear_facets_payload.json \ ${api}/facet-loader/clear)
echo "Facet clear response (HTTP ${HTTP_CODE}):" cat clear_facets_response.json || true
# Upload response to S3 for audit aws s3 cp "clear_facets_response.json" "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/resources/clear_facets_response.json" --no-progress
# Cleanup unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
echo "Facet clear job completed."
